161489591.title: Plane Pal Travel Pillow
161489591.detail_text: Description Plane Pal is a custom designed inflatable cushion that fills the space between your child’s seat and the seat in front. Made from high quality nylon, Plane Pal is light weight and compact for stress free, easy inflation after take-off. Plane Pal can also be used on trains and buses and for car travel. It's recommended to inflate the Plane Pal orally instead. It only takes 6 breaths after you have taken the time to stretch the Plane Pal out with your hands first. Important Information Plane Pal is not a toy. Use under direct supervision. Do not use as a flotation device. Do not jump onto Plane Pal. Take care to avoid sharp objects when you open, pack, store and inflate. Do not over inflate Plane Pal. The information provided is indicative only and provided on a "best endeavours basis", based on responses from airlines and/or previous customer experiences. In using this information, you accept we can't be held responsible should the airline refuse use. Refunds are not allowed where a third-party carrier refuses a Plane Pal's use.You accept full responsibility for contacting your carrier prior to purchasing to check they don't expressly exclude the use of a Plane Pal onboard, as policies can change frequently e.g from our experience, we do find that depending on who you speak to the answer can change back and forth during one phone call! Care and Maintenance Clean Plane Pal with a soft, damp cloth. Do not immerse in water, or machine wash, or tumble dry. Do not use chemicals to clean Plane Pal. Should Plane Pal receive a puncture, discontinue use immediately. Airlines Approval OVER 50 APPROVED AIRLINES Most airlines are happy to allow the safe use of Plane Pal as per our instructions: Plane Pal is to be used in the window seat or the middle seat in the centre rows Plane Pal is not to be used during take off or landing. The child's seatbelt remains fastened at all times (you can request an infant extender belt to help with this).

The ideal size for handling large and awkward items, Heroclip Medium gear clip lets you hook and hang big backpacks from trees, duffle bags from fences, buckets from ladders, and carry-ons from bathroom stalls. The versatile gear clip hangs securely, rotates 360 degrees, and folds compactly in ways other carabiners, clips and hooks can't, helping you keep your gear organized and exactly where you want it, no matter the activity. The wide carabiner clip gate accommodates bigger stuff compared with standard carabiners and clips, so you can secure anything from extension cord bundles to multiple shopping bags. The hook features a grippy rubber tip for hanging bags and purses from tables and other flat surfaces.
Strong: Sturdy gear clip supports and secures up to 60 lbs.
360 degree Rotation: Fully rotating hook keeps gear accessible.
Pivoting Joints: Hang your stuff from most nooks & crannies.
Compact: Foldable hook nests on gear clip until needed.
This product is not designed for climbing.
-----
A Folding Carabiner Hook Designed for Thousands of Uses
Invented by a working mum, the Heroclip (previously called Qliplet) is just like another pair of hands! A multi-functional tool to make life easier in the least expected places, it is super useful for any traveller & a convenient everyday carry.
Hang Bags on Tables
Keep your bags off the dirty floor! In 5 seconds, the Heroclip transforms into a rubber-edged hook for your bag, and packs neatly into a carabiner after.
Holds Up to 27kg, Create Hanging Spaces At Home
Made of aircraft-grade aluminium, the Heroclip is useful for creating hanging spaces in your house.
Other Interesting Uses:
Keep your photography bag off the muddy ground
Keep your bag off dirty toilet floors
Keep your bag dry / sand free at the beach or the pool

Hang Bags On Tables. Tidy Up The House.

Thousands Of Uses, Literally.

—

Featured on CNN, ESPN, Lifehacker etc.

The patented Heroclip helps you, simply put, hang stuff anywhere – indoors and outdoors.

Keep Bags Off Dirty Floors

Imagine you’re at a crowded cafe or restaurant. Every chair is precious, but so is your expensive bag.

With the Heroclip, you can hang your bag on the table’s edge, keeping it off the floor.

Tidy Your Home

The Heroclip also lets you maximise unused spaces in your house. Hang stuff around!

Super Useful Outdoors

The Heroclip functions like an extra pair of hands. You’ll be especially grateful on hikes.

Aircraft-Grade Aluminium – Holds 27kg

Precision machined from lightweight aircraft grade aluminium and topped off with a sleek anodised finish, the Heroclip is pure quality and class.

Each Heroclip holds up to 27kg. The hook comes with a secure rubber end-grip.

13804594221.detail_text: Specifications BrandOwalaSKU13804594221_SGAMZ-124804572528MaterialInox 304 What’s in the box 1 Highlights For Owala FreeSip 24oz Insulated Stainless Steel Water Bottle, Rolling In Ocean Gradient Leakproof Travel Tumbler Take the soothing rhythm of ocean waves everywhere with the Owala FreeSip 24oz Water Bottle in exclusive Rolling In gradient colorway. Made of premium double-wall vacuum insulated stainless steel, this 24oz capacity tumbler keeps drinks icy cold for up to 24 hours and retains heat for 12 hours, perfectly sized for beach days, daily commutes, gym sessions and weekend outdoor trips. Our patented 2-in-1 FreeSip lid supports two drinking styles: soft straw for gentle sipping and wide mouth for quick gulps. The built-in flip lock forms a tight leakproof seal, no messy spills when tossed in backpacks or beach totes. The dreamy turquoise ombre finish mimics rolling coastal surf, with smooth scratch-resistant glossy coating to keep its premium look for long-term use. Equipped with an integrated portable carry loop, easy to hook on bags and luggage. 24oz moderate large capacity meets all-day hydration demands without extra refills. 100% BPA-free, top rack dishwasher safe, food-safe stainless steel construction. 13804430265.detail_text: Hi. We make water bottles. Why? Well, we’re a motley crew of dreamers and designers who live by a simple creed: “Do more of what you love.”​ And we love designing things that make life a little bit easier and a heckuva a lot more enjoyable. We asked ourselves, with so many different kinds of water bottles out there, why do 3 out of 4 people still suffer from chronic dehydration? So we rolled up our sleeves and got to work. We created what we believe to be the finest water bottles in all the land. Water bottles designed to help you do more of what you love. So, what are you waiting for? Go forth and carpe the diem—hydrated like a boss. FreeSip Spout What makes the Owala FreeSip so different than other bottles? The FreeSip has a patented 2-in-1 spout that rocks BOTH a built-in straw for sipping AND a wide-mouth opening for chugging. That’s right—two different ways to drink. Easy to Clean Designed to be quick and easy to disassemble, with minimal hard-to-reach surfaces. Lid and straw are dishwasher safe. Hand wash cup with Owala 2-in-1 Water Bottle Brush (sold separately). Cup Holder Friendly Base Because you'll want to take this bottle everywhere, the 24-Ounce bottles are cup-holder friendly. Now you can stay hydrated on-the-go. Keeps Drinks Cold Triple-layered, vacuum-insulated stainless steel keeps drinks cold for up to 24-hours. Plus, this bottle is made from BPA- and phthalate-free materials

product.desc:
Hi. We make water bottles.

Why? Well, we’re a motley crew of dreamers and designers who live by a simple creed: “Do more of what you love.”​

And we love designing things that make life a little bit easier and a heckuva a lot more enjoyable. We asked ourselves, with so many different kinds of water bottles out there, why do 3 out of 4 people still suffer from chronic dehydration?

So we rolled up our sleeves and got to work. We created what we believe to be the finest water bottles in all the land. Water bottles designed to help you do more of what you love. So, what are you waiting for? Go forth and carpe the diem—hydrated like a boss.

FreeSip Spout

What makes the Owala FreeSip so different than other bottles? The FreeSip has a patented 2-in-1 spout that rocks BOTH a built-in straw for sipping AND a wide-mouth opening for chugging. That’s right—two different ways to drink.

Easy to Clean

Designed to be quick and easy to disassemble, with minimal hard-to-reach surfaces. Lid and straw are dishwasher safe. Hand wash cup with Owala 2-in-1 Water Bottle Brush (sold separately).

Cup Holder Friendly Base

Because you'll want to take this bottle everywhere, the 24-Ounce bottles are cup-holder friendly. Now you can stay hydrated on-the-go.

Keeps Drinks Cold

Triple-layered, vacuum-insulated stainless steel keeps drinks cold for up to 24-hours. Plus, this bottle is made from BPA- and phthalate-free materials

Plus, this bottle is made from BPA- and phthalate-free materials

3279486835.detail_text: The Ergoworks Easynap Pocket Travel Pillow is your versatile neck support companion for travel and beyond. Its cradling shape gently fits the neck, ensuring comfort whether you’re sleeping or reading on the go. Crafted with temperature-sensitive, visco-elastic material, it adapts to your body’s contours, providing supportive comfort with minimal pressure. The removable, washable covers ensure easy hygiene maintenance, keeping your pillow fresh for every journey. FEATURES Versatile Neck Support: The Ergoworks Easynap Pocket Travel Pillow serves as your ideal neck companion during travels or whenever additional neck support is required. Cradling Shape: The pillow’s design delicately cradles the neck, ensuring a secure fit and allowing for more comfortable sleeping or reading while on the go. Temperature-Sensitive Material: Embedded with Ergoworks, a temperature-sensitive, visco-elastic material, all Ergoworks Home and Travel products conform to your body’s shape, offering comfortable support with minimal counter pressure. Removable, Washable Covers: The pillow covers are easily removable, facilitating convenient washing for hygiene maintenance and prolonged freshness. SPECIFICATIONS Dimensions (case size):12 x 18 x 6cm Small size: suitable for the people with neck circumference between 37-33 cm (14 1/2 – 13 inches) Weight: 290g

3252122842.title: Mazer Fly-Mate Pro Duo (M-FlyMate Pro DUO) Wireless Bluetooth 5.0 Transmitter Travel Airplane Flight Adapter Bluetooth
3252122842.detail_text: Fly-Mate Duo IN-FLIGHT WIRELESS AUDIO ADAPTER FOR AIRPODS AND OTHER BLUETOOTH HEADPHONES ● The Fly-Mate Duo Bluetooth audio transmitter lets you stream wireless audio to your Air Pods or other Bluetooth headphones from devices that do not have built-in Bluetooth, such as in-flight entertainment systems HD WIRELESS SOUND FOR YOUR TRAVELS ● The Fly-Mater Duo audio transmitter enables in-flight entertainment systems and other devices to stream high-quality digital audio over Bluetooth HOW IT WORKS ? 1. Connect to in-flight entertainment system or any other 3.5mm audio jack 2. Pair with up to two Air Pods or other Bluetooth headphones 3. Enjoy the crisp, high-quality wireless sound BLUETOOTH AUDIO FOR DEVICES WITHOUT BUILT-IN BLUETOOTH Works with airplane entertainment systems and all other audio devices with standard 3.5mm audio output, including Xbox / PlayStation controllers, Nintendo Switch, and computers DUAL-HEADPHONE STREAMING Stream audio to up to two Air Pods or other Bluetooth headphones or speakers HIGH-FIDELITY DIGITAL SOUND The Fly-Mate Duo transmits clear, distortion-free digital audio with no white noise, no need to find the right frequency, and no way for a stranger to listen in on your audio stream QUALCOMM® APTX™ LOW LATENCY TECHNOLOGY Supported audio codecs include Qualcomm® aptX™, which provides improved audio fidelity and clarity, and Qualcomm® aptX™ Low Latency, which minimizes audio delay and prevents lip-synching issues with aptX™ Low Latency-enabled headphones. 10-HOUR BATTERY LIFE Built-in battery provides up to 15 hours of playtime with one connected headphone or 10 hours with two, features a LED Digital status indicator, and can be used while charging.
3252122842.detail_html:
Fly-Mate Duo IN-FLIGHT WIRELESS AUDIO ADAPTER FOR AIRPODS AND OTHER BLUETOOTH HEADPHONES

● The Fly-Mate Duo Bluetooth audio transmitter lets you stream wireless audio to your Air Pods or other Bluetooth headphones from devices that do not have built-in Bluetooth, such as in-flight entertainment systems

HD WIRELESS SOUND FOR YOUR TRAVELS

● The Fly-Mater Duo audio transmitter enables in-flight entertainment systems and other devices to stream high-quality digital audio over Bluetooth

HOW IT WORKS ?

1. Connect to in-flight entertainment system or any other 3.5mm audio jack

2. Pair with up to two Air Pods or other Bluetooth headphones

3. Enjoy the crisp, high-quality wireless sound

BLUETOOTH AUDIO FOR DEVICES WITHOUT BUILT-IN BLUETOOTH

Works with airplane entertainment systems and all other audio devices with standard 3.5mm audio output, including Xbox / PlayStation controllers, Nintendo Switch, and computers

DUAL-HEADPHONE STREAMING

Stream audio to up to two Air Pods or other Bluetooth headphones or speakers

HIGH-FIDELITY DIGITAL SOUND

The Fly-Mate Duo transmits clear, distortion-free digital audio with no white noise, no need to find the right frequency, and no way for a stranger to listen in on your audio stream

QUALCOMM® APTX™ LOW LATENCY TECHNOLOGY

Supported audio codecs include Qualcomm® aptX™, which provides improved audio fidelity and clarity, and Qualcomm® aptX™ Low Latency, which minimizes audio delay and prevents lip-synching issues with aptX™ Low Latency-enabled headphones.

10-HOUR BATTERY LIFE

Built-in battery provides up to 15 hours of playtime with one connected headphone or 10 hours with two, features a LED Digital status indicator, and can be used while charging.

● The Fly-Mate Duo Bluetooth audio transmitter lets you stream wireless audio to your Air Pods or other Bluetooth headphones from devices that do not have built-in Bluetooth, such as in-flight entertainment systems

HD WIRELESS SOUND FOR YOUR TRAVELS

● The Fly-Mater Duo audio transmitter enables in-flight entertainment systems and other devices to stream high-quality digital audio over Bluetooth

HOW IT WORKS ?

1. Connect to in-flight entertainment system or any other 3.5mm audio jack

2. Pair with up to two Air Pods or other Bluetooth headphones

3. Enjoy the crisp, high-quality wireless sound

BLUETOOTH AUDIO FOR DEVICES WITHOUT BUILT-IN BLUETOOTH

Works with airplane entertainment systems and all other audio devices with standard 3.5mm audio output, including Xbox / PlayStation controllers, Nintendo Switch, and computers

DUAL-HEADPHONE STREAMING

Stream audio to up to two Air Pods or other Bluetooth headphones or speakers

HIGH-FIDELITY DIGITAL SOUND

The Fly-Mate Duo transmits clear, distortion-free digital audio with no white noise, no need to find the right frequency, and no way for a stranger to listen in on your audio stream

QUALCOMM® APTX™ LOW LATENCY TECHNOLOGY

Supported audio codecs include Qualcomm® aptX™, which provides improved audio fidelity and clarity, and Qualcomm® aptX™ Low Latency, which minimizes audio delay and prevents lip-synching issues with aptX™ Low Latency-enabled headphones.

10-HOUR BATTERY LIFE

Built-in battery provides up to 15 hours of playtime with one connected headphone or 10 hours with two, features a LED Digital status indicator, and can be used while charging.

3279505999.detail_text: The Ergoworks Easynap Pocket Travel Pillow is your versatile neck support companion for travel and beyond. Its cradling shape gently fits the neck, ensuring comfort whether you’re sleeping or reading on the go. Crafted with temperature-sensitive, visco-elastic material, it adapts to your body’s contours, providing supportive comfort with minimal pressure. The removable, washable covers ensure easy hygiene maintenance, keeping your pillow fresh for every journey. FEATURES Versatile Neck Support: The Ergoworks Easynap Pocket Travel Pillow serves as your ideal neck companion during travels or whenever additional neck support is required. Cradling Shape: The pillow’s design delicately cradles the neck, ensuring a secure fit and allowing for more comfortable sleeping or reading while on the go. Temperature-Sensitive Material: Embedded with Ergoworks, a temperature-sensitive, visco-elastic material, all Ergoworks Home and Travel products conform to your body’s shape, offering comfortable support with minimal counter pressure. Removable, Washable Covers: The pillow covers are easily removable, facilitating convenient washing for hygiene maintenance and prolonged freshness. SPECIFICATIONS Dimensions (case size):12 x 18 x 6cm Large size: suitable for the people with neck circumference between 42-38 cm (16 1/2 – 15 inches) Weight: 320 g

3171698710.title: [Peak Design] Multi-Function Toiletry Wash Pouch
3171698710.detail_text: Wash Pouch Dopp kit, ditty bag, toiletry bag, call it what you will—it’s one of the most essential travel carry tools, and can also be one of the most frustrating. In designing Wash Kit, we aimed to create the perfect balance between elegant simplicity and thoughtful functionality. Sits upright on the counter or hangs via a stowable hook, always giving total visibility and access to your toiletries. A network of internal TPU-coated nylon mesh pockets, along with a magnetically-sealed toothbrush pocket, external razor pocket, and internal zippered pouch, keep items organized and clean. All pockets easily turn inside out for quick cleaning.

13805112069.detail_text: MAZER Travel Essentials 3-in-1 Bundle PowerCharge Nano 10,000mAh PD35W Power Bank + InfiniteTravel565 65W Travel Charger + Premium Felt Pouch Everything you need to stay powered wherever you go. The MAZER Travel Essentials 3-in-1 Bundle combines a high-speed portable power bank, a compact universal travel charger, and a premium felt pouch to keep your charging essentials organized at home, work, or while travelling. Whether you're catching a flight, working remotely, or exploring a new destination, this bundle ensures your devices are always charged and ready. Key Features: 🔋 PowerCharge Nano 10,000mAh PD35W Power Bank -10,000mAh capacity for reliable all-day power -PD/PPS 35W fast charging for smartphones, tablets and compatible laptops -Dual built-in USB-C cables — no extra cable required -USB-C input/output port for additional charging flexibility -Ultra-compact nano-sized design (only 183g) -Intelligent temperature control for safer charging -Flight-approved (38.5Wh, UN38.3 Passed) -CCC Certified for compliant air travel in applicable regions 🌍 InfiniteTravel565 65W Universal Travel Charger -Powerful 65W USB-C PD fast charging -Dual USB-C ports (65W Max or 45W + 20W simultaneous charging) -Latest GaN7 technology for smaller size and higher efficiency -Universal travel adapter with US, UK, EU & AU plugs -Compatible in over 224 countries -Charges up to 2 laptops or multiple USB-C devices -Built-in Pin-Lock System keeps travel plugs securely in place -6-layer protection system for safe charging -USB-C charging cable included 👜 Premium Felt Storage Pouch -Keeps your power bank, travel charger and cables neatly organized -Protects your accessories from scratches during travel -Lightweight and easy to carry in backpacks, handbags or luggage Bundle Includes 1 × MAZER PowerCharge Nano 10,000mAh PD35W Power Bank 1 × MAZER InfiniteTravel565 65W Universal Travel Charger 1 × Premium Felt Pouch

MAZER Travel Essentials 3-in-1 Bundle

PowerCharge Nano 10,000mAh PD35W Power Bank + InfiniteTravel565 65W Travel Charger + Premium Felt Pouch

Everything you need to stay powered wherever you go. -10,000mAh capacity for reliable all-day power

-Dual built-in USB-C cables — no extra cable required

-Keeps your power bank, travel charger and cables neatly organized

-Protects your accessories from scratches during travel

-Lightweight and easy to carry in backpacks, handbags or luggage

Bundle Includes

1 × MAZER PowerCharge Nano 10,000mAh PD35W Power Bank

1 × MAZER InfiniteTravel565 65W Universal Travel Charger

1 × Premium Felt Pouch

product.desc:
MAZER Travel Essentials 3-in-1 Bundle

PowerCharge Nano 10,000mAh PD35W Power Bank + InfiniteTravel565 65W Travel Charger + Premium Felt Pouch

Everything you need to stay powered wherever you go. The MAZER Travel Essentials 3-in-1 Bundle combines a high-speed portable power bank, a compact universal travel charger, and a premium felt pouch to keep your charging essentials organized at home, work, or while travelling. Whether you're catching a flight, working remotely, or exploring a new destination, this bundle ensures your devices are always charged and ready.

Key Features:

🔋 PowerCharge Nano 10,000mAh PD35W Power Bank

-10,000mAh capacity for reliable all-day power

-PD/PPS 35W fast charging for smartphones, tablets and compatible laptops

-Dual built-in USB-C cables — no extra cable required

-USB-C input/output port for additional charging flexibility

-Ultra-compact nano-sized design (only 183g)

-Intelligent temperature control for safer charging

-Flight-approved (38.5Wh, UN38.3 Passed)

-CCC Certified for compliant air travel in applicable regions

🌍 InfiniteTravel565 65W Universal Travel Charger

-Powerful 65W USB-C PD fast charging

-Dual USB-C ports (65W Max or 45W + 20W simultaneous charging)

-Latest GaN7 technology for smaller size and higher efficiency

-Universal travel adapter with US, UK, EU & AU plugs

-Compatible in over 224 countries

-Charges up to 2 laptops or multiple USB-C devices

-Built-in Pin-Lock System keeps travel plugs securely in place

-6-layer protection system for safe charging

-USB-C charging cable included

👜 Premium Felt Storage Pouch

-Keeps your power bank, travel charger and cables neatly organized

-Protects your accessories from scratches during travel

-Lightweight and easy to carry in backpacks, handbags or luggage

Bundle Includes

1 × MAZER PowerCharge Nano 10,000mAh PD35W Power Bank

1 × MAZER InfiniteTravel565 65W Universal Travel Charger

1 × Premium Felt Pouch
